remake.swap: 1) the scooter DRIVER (white short-sleeve mesh shirt, dark shorts) becomes the Shiba Inu from image 1: Shiba head, and his arms, hands, legs and feet become thick furry Shiba legs with round paws; 2) the SHIRTLESS REAR PASSENGER becomes a golden retriever: retriever head and his whole bare chest, belly, back, raised arm, armpit and legs become a fully furry golden retriever body and furry legs (no bare human skin left anywhere); 3) the hand that holds the ice-cream bar coming in from the frame edge becomes one furry dog paw; 4) the bystander in the checked shirt and jeans becomes a real mixed-breed dog walking upright the same way
remake.ending: Right after the crash, in the same sunny street next to the tipped-over scooter and the rolled grey trash bin, the same Shiba Inu in the white mesh shirt sits on the pavement, its fur and shirt smeared with melted white ice cream and dust; it pulls one wet wipe out of the pink pet wet-wipe pack (the real product from the image, pink pack with a navy lid) and briskly wipes the ice cream off its muzzle and chest, the pack standing upright on the ground right beside it with the label facing the camera; the golden retriever sits dazed in the background.

beats.text: Photorealistic handheld phone footage from behind a moving black scooter on a sunny road lined with green hedges. [0.0-0.5s] the golden retriever passenger keeps its right front leg raised high; the dog paw entering from the right edge rubs the vanilla ice-cream bar back and forth in the fur under that leg. [0.5-1.5s] two more quick rubs; the retriever's ears flatten and it pulls a disgusted face. [1.5-2.2s] the retriever turns its head away from the camera, eyes squinting. The Shiba driver keeps riding in front. Camera shakes slightly with the ride, no cuts.

Photorealistic handheld phone footage on the moving scooter. [0.0-0.3s] quick whip-pan arriving on the Shiba driver in the white mesh shirt. [0.3-1.4s] the Shiba twists its head back toward the camera and laughs hard with its mouth wide open, shoulders shaking. [1.4-1.9s] it keeps laughing and faces forward again, paws on the handlebars. No cuts.

Photorealistic handheld phone footage on the moving scooter. [0.0-0.6s] the Shiba driver laughing with its mouth open; the dog paw pops the vanilla ice-cream bar straight into its open mouth. [0.6-1.2s] the Shiba clamps its jaws on the bar, eyes squeezing shut. [1.2-2.2s] it keeps riding forward with the ice-cream stick sticking out of its mouth, chewing, unaware. No cuts.

Photorealistic phone footage on a sunny pavement by green hedges. [0.0-0.5s] the golden retriever hops off the back of the black scooter. [0.5-1.1s] the scooter wobbles and its front bumps a big grey plastic trash bin, which tips over and falls. No cuts.

board_notes: a fluffy golden retriever (fully furry body, no human skin) sits on the back of a black scooter holding one front leg high; a furry dog paw from the right rubs a small neat vanilla ice-cream bar into the fur under its raised leg; the Shiba driver in a white mesh shirt sits in front. Keep the ice cream tidy: no dripping liquid.
the Shiba driver in the white mesh short-sleeve shirt turns back toward the camera laughing with its mouth wide open, furry paws on the scooter handlebars.

extreme close-up of golden retriever underarm fur with a squashed vanilla ice-cream bar pressed into the fur and a few smudges; the bar is held by a furry dog paw. Funny, not messy: no dripping liquid.
a furry dog paw pops the vanilla ice-cream bar into the open, laughing mouth of the Shiba driver (white mesh shirt); the Shiba's eyes squeeze shut in surprise.
the Shiba driver on the black scooter bumping into a big grey plastic trash bin that tips over; the golden retriever hops off behind; furry legs only.
close-up of the Shiba driver's face frozen in a disgusted yell, a bit of ice cream on its lips and nose, white mesh shirt.
